name: jellyfin-media-preview-plugin
description: TypeScript build for the Jellyfin Media Preview client bundle.

scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:dotnet
scripts.format:dotnet: dotnet format Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview/Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.csproj whitespace --no-restore && dotnet format Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.Tests/Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.Tests.csproj whitespace --no-restore
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:dotnet
scripts.format:check:dotnet: dotnet format Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview/Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.csproj whitespace --no-restore --verify-no-changes && dotnet format Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.Tests/Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaPreview.Tests.csproj whitespace --no-restore --verify-no-changes
scripts.build: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts
